headline: End of an era: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
summary: The legendary forward ends a historic career with 234 appearances and 146 goals for Portugal, as manager Jorge Jesus names the first squad without him.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football on social media, ending a legendary career with 234 appearances and 146 goals for the Portuguese national team.
Following the announcement, Portugal manager Jorge Jesus named his first squad without the 41-year-old captain, introducing seven new faces, including five from the Under-21s.

The new call-ups include Alberto Costa, Antonio Silva, Matheus Fernandes, Carlos Forbs, Geovany Quenda, Rodrigo Mora, and Gustavo Varela for the upcoming Nations League matches against Wales and Denmark.

The retirement comes amid reports of a public rift between Ronaldo and Jorge Jesus, with the forward having left the camp without permission in September after citing broken promises from the manager.
During a press conference, Jorge Jesus maintained that his decisions were always made with the team in mind and claimed he only learned of Ronaldo's retirement at the same time as the public.
Portuguese FA president Pedro Proenca promised to honor Ronaldo's legacy, stating that no tribute will ever be enough to thank him for his contributions to Portuguese football.

Despite the transition, Portugal remains in a strong position, having won their first four matches to qualify for the Nations League quarter-finals and needing just one point to clinch the top spot in their group.

headline_marked: 6 armed men [[shoot businessman in Cox’s Bazar]] in broad daylight
headline: 6 armed men shoot businessman in Cox’s Bazar in broad daylight
summary: Mahmudul Haque, 45, is in critical condition after being intercepted by attackers on three motorcycles.
details: A 45-year-old businessman, Mahmudul Haque, was shot by six armed men on three motorcycles in Cox’s Bazar Sadar upazila today.
The attack occurred around 3:00 pm in front of the Lal Golap Community Centre in Khurulia while the victim was traveling in a microbus toward Ramu.

According to the victim, the attackers intercepted his vehicle and fired three shots at him. He added that one attacker attempted to shoot him in the head at close range, but the firearm failed to discharge.
Mahmudul managed to escape the scene by running away. He has identified four of the attackers as Zayed, Kitab Ali, Wazed Ali, and Abu Naser.
He was initially taken to Cox’s Bazar Sadar Hospital and later referred to a hospital in Chattogram due to his critical condition.
Police have seized one motorcycle in connection with the incident and are currently investigating the matter and collecting the victim's statement.

According to the victim, the attackers intercepted his vehicle and fired three shots at him. He added that one attacker attempted to shoot him in the head at close range, but the firearm failed to discharge.

Mahmudul managed to escape the scene by running away. He has identified four of the attackers as Zayed, Kitab Ali, Wazed Ali, and Abu Naser.

He was initially taken to Cox’s Bazar Sadar Hospital and later referred to a hospital in Chattogram due to his critical condition.

Police have seized one motorcycle in connection with the incident and are currently investigating the matter and collecting the victim's statement.
